purpose: Operator-only question capture and real terminal answer delivery; no app build
source: Actual WT browser UI, independently compared with existing native collector

tests.prompt: This is a question-and-answer check only. Do not build an app, use tools, create files or access data. Ask me exactly this one question in ordinary text, without a question form: Which bakery orders should appear first? Then wait for my answer. After I answer, repeat my exact answer in one sentence and stop.
tests.answer: Orders due today that are not ready should appear first.

tests.prompt: This is a question-and-answer check only. Do not build an app, create files or access data. Use your native AskUserQuestion form to ask two questions together: (1) Which bakery orders should appear first? with options Orders due today (recommended), All outstanding orders; (2) What order information should the page show? as a multi-select with options Pickup time, Customer name, Order status. Wait for my selections. After submission, state exactly which choices I selected, then stop.

This is a question-and-answer check only. Do not build an app, use tools, create files or access data. Ask me exactly this one question in ordinary text: Which bakery orders should appear first? Then wait for my answer. After I answer, repeat my exact answer in one sentence and stop.
tests.answer: Orders due today that are not ready should appear first.

pass_conditions: Question is visible and understood before any answer is submitted
Normal terminal UI submission delivers the intended answer or all selected choices
Assistant acknowledges exactly that answer or those choices
Record UI and collector verdicts separately; missing collector records do not fail agent behavior
